body:
Approve to ship a version with 4.5 that does not crash with multithreading and Jolt but to be clear, this can only be a stopgap solution as this is closer to a hack than a fix.

This is not mihe or Jolt's fault. The PhysicsServer and related physics nodes always had major problems with multithreading. The physics system design is fundamentally flawed for threading in Godot. (e.g. allowing internal node calls to force sync and lock the server is a major design flaw as nodes should have zero say what and when the server does anything).

I remember in old Godot there was even a big warning on the physics threading setting to never use it in production but for some reason it was removed without anything fixed.

The physics threading problems are basically the original NavigationServer threading disaster all over (because the original NavigationServer copied the PhysicsServer design) just in different context, with more users and even worse exposed API functions on server and nodes (e.g. only look at the CharacterBody code when you are not already depressed or prone to violent outbursts).
